citation: Cao, Fatemi, Fang, Watanabe, Taniguchi, Kaxiras & Jarillo-Herrero, "Magic-angle graphene superlattices: a new platform for unconventional superconductivity", Nature 556, 43 (2018); arXiv:1803.02342v2
license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license; facts and numbers only, no text or figures reproduced
topic: In an MA-TBG device (twist angle 1.16°), transport near the boundary between the superconducting dome and the half-filling insulator shows oscillations in a perpendicular magnetic field B.

facts.text: At a density of -1.48 × 10^12 cm^-2 the critical current is largest at B = 0 and oscillates periodically in B with a period of 22.5 mT.
facts.locator: Methods, Phase-coherent transport (pp. 14-15); Extended Data Fig. 1a

facts.text: The device area between the voltage probes is approximately 1 µm^2.
The electrical contacts are non-superconducting Cr/Au, so no superconductivity is induced by proximity to the leads.

ask: Treat the oscillation as flux quantization through a superconducting loop and find the effective loop area. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

error.reason: 用正常态磁通量子 h/e（量子霍尔用）而不是超导磁通量子 h/2e，面积大了一倍。

paper.text: The loop is roughly a tenth of the device area, so the oscillation comes from SQUID-like superconducting loops around insulating islands: the superconducting state is spatially inhomogeneous on this scale.
paper.locator: Methods, Phase-coherent transport (p. 15): S ≈ 0.09 µm² vs ~1 µm² device; Josephson junction arrays around insulating islands

rejected.text: The loop is essentially the whole device, so the oscillation shows a single uniform superconducting ring spanning the Hall bar.
rejected.locator: Methods (p. 15): the area is compared with ~1 µm² and attributed to inhomogeneity
rejected.reason: 算出的面积远小于器件面积，原文据此推断存在绝缘“岛”与不均匀性，不是整个器件一个均匀环。

scale.definition: 超导环路的等效尺寸 √S（约 0.3 μm）
